summary: Master healthcare waste management with our 5-day course. Learn WHO standards, medical waste tracking, and clinical safety protocols. Enroll today.
lede: Medical waste management is the process of identifying, sorting, and handling healthcare waste to reduce infection and environmental risks. This training is for professionals responsible for waste, infection prevention, facilities, or clinical operations; it covers waste assessments, segregation audits, treatment selection, and digital tracking and reporting.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals responsible for the safety, compliance, and environmental footprint of healthcare delivery environments.
audience: Sustainability Officers focused on healthcare circular economy
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2 years of experience in healthcare operations, infection control, or facility management. A basic understanding of clinical environments and safety protocols is required. No prior specialized engineering knowledge is needed, though familiarity with ISO 14001 or WHO Blue Book concepts is advantageous.
